# uptimekuma_docker_hosts (Data Source)

Lists the Docker hosts configured on the Uptime Kuma instance.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "uptimekuma_docker_hosts" "all" {}

output "docker_host_names" {
  value = [for host in data.uptimekuma_docker_hosts.all.docker_hosts : host.name]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `docker_hosts` (Attributes List) The Docker hosts, ordered by ID. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--docker_hosts))

<a id="nestedatt--docker_hosts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `docker_hosts`

Read-Only:

- `connection_type` (String) `socket` or `tcp`.
- `daemon` (String) Socket path or TCP address.
- `id` (String) Numeric ID of the Docker host.
- `name` (String) Name of the Docker host.
